overview: S3B carries scoreboard objective lifecycle state, and only Shard touches it. The monitor HUD system consumes and emits the packet family: ScoreboardSlotObserver reads S3B REMOVE actions and S3D display binds to detect when its claimed sidebar slot is displaced, and ScoreboardPacketBridge builds the S3B objectives, S3D display binds and S3C score rows that render the monitor sidebar. Everything else in the corpus is plumbing or sibling-family noise: Negativity's SCOREBOARD_OBJECTIVE constant and Artemis' four scoreboard wrapper interfaces with their PacketRepository entries register the family, intave's ScoreboardAccessor and EntityCollisionDisabler build and read PacketPlayOutScoreboardTeam (S3E), NCP's CollisionUtil uses the Bukkit scoreboard API for team-collision lookups, and BetterAnticheat's ReloadCommand hits on a comment.

checks.name: ScoreboardSlotObserver (Shard)
checks.purpose: Watches the scoreboard objective and display streams so the monitor HUD notices when its claimed sidebar slot is taken over or its objective is removed by the server or another plugin.
checks.how_it_works: MONITOR-priority PacketSendEvent listener active only while the slot registry holds claims. For S3B it wraps the event as WrapperPlayServerScoreboardObjective and, when the mode is REMOVE and the objective name matches a claim, fires the claim's onSlotLost callback; for S3D it compares the display slot against the claim and fires onSlotLost with a DISPLACED reason when a foreign objective binds there. The callback is deferred through tasksAfterSend onto the main thread.
checks.detects: None; it is a coordination observer. It detects slot loss so the monitor view can re-assert its sidebar or fall back.
checks.variations: ScoreboardPacketBridge is the emission half of the same monitor: it writes the objectives and display binds this observer reads.

checks.name: ScoreboardPacketBridge (Shard)
checks.purpose: Emits the scoreboard objective, display and score packets that render Shard's monitor HUD sidebar for a viewer.
checks.how_it_works: createObjective sends an S3B CREATE objective (name, INTEGER render type, component title, optional fixed score format) followed by an S3D display bind to the target slot; removeObjective sends an S3B REMOVE. updateEntry and removeEntry maintain the S3C score rows, choosing reset-score packets on servers that support fancy text (1.20.3+). All packets go out through the PacketEvents player manager.
checks.detects: None; it is the writer side of a HUD. The bridge is the emission half of the scoreboard observer's coordination loop.
checks.variations: No other anticheat emits or reads S3B; the rest of the corpus registers the family (Negativity, Artemis) or touches the sibling S3E team packet (intave).
